summary: Arterial kerb beside apartments, no kerbside parking and a peak-hour No Stopping sign.

best_section.where: Sir Fred Schonell Drive south kerb, before the side-street corner

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 9 m away at the start and 28 m mid-way, a house 21 m across the way; overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a narrow verge edge with trees and hedge behind; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with two lanes and marked centre line.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb in either image; sign bans stopping 4-6:30pm Mon-Fri.

sun_shade: Tree canopy and hedge on the south side; partly shaded.
